title: No bail to be granted in respect of certain offences.
text: (1) Notwithstanding anything contained in sections 496 and 497 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898, no person accused of an offence punishable under this Act with death or imprisonment for life or imprisonment for a term exceeding five years shall be released on bail unless the prosecution has been given notice and there appear reasonable grounds for believing that the accused is not guilty of such offence.
